# E1004: the tip cannot be cut while a lens on its edge is missing

The tip removes a field without writing the lenses that say where the
field goes, and is cut. A version that has been cut never changes, so the
lenses on the edge into it have to be written before it is: the development
path tolerates a missing lens as a warning (E1001), and cutting refuses it.
Each lens still missing is a note. Write the lenses in `tip.thema`, then cut
it.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E1004]: the tip cannot be cut as 1.0 while a lens on its edge is missing
 --> tip.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: tip.thema has no ForwardLens, and one cannot be derived
  = note: tip.thema has no BackwardLens, and one cannot be derived
  = note: a version that has been cut never changes, so the lenses into it are written before it is
  = help: write the missing lenses in tip.thema, then cut it
```
